_comment: vendor_id -> where we may write, and who may write back.
Copy this file to vendors.json and put real addresses in it. vendors.json
is gitignored for the same reason data/chat/roster.json is: it names real
This one file does both jobs. Outbound, it is the allowlist -- an invoice
whose vendor is absent is never mailed, it goes to a human. Inbound, the
domain here is what an incoming reply's sender is checked against; a reply
from anywhere else is kept as evidence but takes no automatic action.
